department: Revenue Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
what_it_is: The Community Certificate is a certificate from the Revenue Department of Tamil Nadu. You can ask for it online through e-Sevai.
documents: Community certificate of your father, mother, or brother or sister
how_to_apply: Make a free login on the e-Sevai citizen site with 'sign up', or go to an e-Sevai centre. You need a CAN (Citizen Access Number). Fill the form, upload your papers and pay. When the officer approves and signs it digitally, you can download the certificate. Check where it is with 'Check Status' and your application number.
where_to_apply: Any e-Sevai centre (Common Service Centre), or online at tnesevai.tn.gov.in.
fee: Rs 60 service charge at e-Sevai. No department charge (Rs 0).
